tagline: CADCraft on a Selkies web desktop: 2D drafting with layers, blocks and dimensions, and DXF and DWG files, all in the browser.
description: CADCraft, 2D drafting and DXF/DWG drawings in the spirit of AutoCAD, on a Selkies web desktop. It runs in your browser without a VNC client or a local install, on amd64 and arm64.
author: Junker der Provinz
title: CADCraft
